Railway RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Railway RRB Group D Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Railway RRB Ministerial and Isolated Admit Card : Railway RRB Paramedical Recruitment

Application Fee

  • सहायक पी-वे (Assistant P-Way) : 300
  • Railway RRB Ministerial and Isolated Admit Card : Railway RRB Paramedical Recruitment

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
